trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback on Android 14 that occurs when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload (top crasher, ~4% of Android sessions). Fix and verify by Wednesday (before the August 20 release) so QA has time. Sam to confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression run.

trello.name: Build sync API for offline notes list
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Build the backend sync endpoint this sprint: client sends last-synced timestamp and receives a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins; no merge UI in this pass. Have the sync API in review before Elena is out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Implement local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: user can open the app in airplane mode, see notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Write these acceptance criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Finish the test and release pipelines (proof of concept for build job already exists), keep the nightly build schedule, and run GitHub Actions and Jenkins in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Jenkins must stay alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that, and add a metrics counter so it is visible who is hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update privacy policy consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Get new copy from legal and rebuild the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, nothing pre-checked (replacing the single pre-checked box). Launch blocker; must be in the August 20 mobile release.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Write regression tests covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
